schedule.webhook: Real-time error intake from all scenarios

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Slack incoming webhook URL for #safeflow-alerts channel

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_OPS.description: Slack incoming webhook URL for #safeflow-ops channel (daily digest)

OPS_EMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Operations team email address for critical alerts and daily digest

OPS_EMAIL_FROM.description: From address for outgoing alert emails

monitoring.success_metric: Errors received and classified without failure
monitoring.error_threshold: Any DLQ execution failure is critical (check Make.com execution logs directly)
monitoring.latency_target: < 5 seconds for error intake and classification

severity_definitions.CRITICAL: Immediate attention required. Data corruption risk or complete scenario failure. Slack + email alert.
severity_definitions.HIGH: Service degradation. Upstream API failures, persistent errors. Slack alert.
severity_definitions.MEDIUM: Individual message/record failure. Invalid data, recipient issues. Logged for daily digest.
severity_definitions.LOW: Transient issues. Rate limits, temporary network errors. Logged only.

changelog.changes: Initial error handler with severity classification, Slack and email alerts, auto-retry with exponential backoff, and daily error digest
